properties.name: pua_roundtrip
properties.formal: forall v in (ASCII + lone continuation bytes)*. walk_decode(bytes_to_string(v)) = v

properties.name: truncate_extend_reference
properties.formal: forall x:u64, w in 1..=64, s:bool. truncate_and_extend_bits(x,w,s).0 = (mask/sign-extend reference) and is idempotent

properties.name: div_rem_c99_identity
properties.formal: forall a,b (b!=0), width, signedness. (a/b)*b + a%b = a (mod 2^w) via eval_const_binop

properties.name: div_by_zero_none
properties.formal: forall a, width, signedness. eval(Div,a,0)=None and eval(Mod,a,0)=None

properties.name: cmp_totality
properties.formal: forall a,b,width,signedness. lt+eq+gt=1, le=lt|eq, ge=gt|eq, ne=!eq, lt(a,b)=gt(b,a)

properties.name: f64_native_differential
properties.formal: forall finite a,b, op in {+,-,*,/} (0/0 excluded). to_f64(eval(op,F64(a),F64(b))) = a op b bitwise

properties.name: f128_lossless_roundtrip
properties.counterexample: x = 0.5 (biased_exp = 1022 < 1023): 'd.biased_exp as u128 - 1023' underflows -> panic 'attempt to subtract with overflow' in debug, garbage exponent in release. Also x = f64::from_bits(1) (subnormal, biased_exp = 0).

properties.name: f128_single_rounding
properties.formal: forall finite normal a,b, op in {+,-,*,/}. f128_bytes_to_f64(f128_op(enc(a),enc(b))).to_bits() = (a op b).to_bits() (f128 arithmetic on f64-exact operands is exact, so one correctly-rounded narrowing equals native f64)
properties.counterexample: any operand pair with |a| < 1.0 or |b| < 1.0 (e.g. a = 0.5): panics inside f64_to_f128_bytes_lossless (same root cause as b1); once that is fixed this property also isolates the f128_bytes_to_f64 truncation (b3)

properties.name: x87_f128_bridge_differential
properties.formal: forall normal x87 bytes b. f128_bytes_to_f64(x87_bytes_to_f128_bytes(b)).to_bits() = x87_bytes_to_f64(b).to_bits()
properties.counterexample: x87 2^0 x 1.111...1 (all-ones 64-bit mantissa, bytes[..8]=u64::MAX.to_le_bytes(), exp=0x3FFF): direct (round-to-nearest) = 2.0, via exact f128 bridge (truncating) = 1.9999999999999998

properties.name: x87_f64_roundtrip
properties.counterexample: x = f64::from_bits(1) = 5e-324 (smallest positive subnormal): encoded as ~2.22e-308 (implicit-leading-1 assumption on a subnormal mantissa), decodes to +0.0 (bits 0x0 vs expected 0x1)

properties.name: builtin_bitops_differential
properties.formal: forall v:i64 (clz/ctz of 0 excluded as GCC-undefined). builtin(v) = rust_native(v) for clz/ctz/clzll/ctzll/popcount(ll)/parity(ll)/ffs, and ffs(0)=0

properties.name: bswap_semantics
properties.formal: forall v:i64. bswapN(v) = (v as uN).swap_bytes() zero-extended for the result width, and bswap32(bswap32(v)) = (v as u32)
properties.counterexample: __builtin_bswap32 with v = -5495501120125551105 (low u32 after bswap = 0xFFBBD010 >= 2^31): folded constant reads back -4380928 (signed I32) instead of 4290586368 (zero-extended unsigned int)

properties.name: align_up_laws
properties.formal: forall o:usize, a power-of-two >= 1 without overflow. align_up(o,a)%a=0 and align_up(o,a)>=o and align_up(o,a)-o<a and align_up(align_up(o,a),a)=align_up(o,a)

properties.name: negate_bitnot_involution
properties.formal: forall v. negate_const(negate_const(v)) = v value-wise; bitnot_const(bitnot_const(v)) = v for I8/I16/I32/I64/I128

properties.name: fxhash_write_consistency
properties.formal: forall v. write_uN(v).finish() = write(&v.to_ne_bytes()).finish() (N=8,16,32,64) and forall 8-aligned s1, any s2. write(s1);write(s2) = write(s1||s2)

properties.name: symbol_table_scope_shadowing
properties.formal: automaton(scope stack; ops push_scope/declare/lookup/pop_scope; invariant: lookup returns innermost binding; popping a scope removes its bindings and restores outer visibility; the global scope survives)

bugs.summary: f64_to_f128_bytes_lossless corrupts every |x| < 1.0 (u128 underflow: panic in debug, garbage exponent in release)
bugs.impact: Every double/long double constant with magnitude < 1.0 on ARM64/RISC-V: compiler panic (debug) or silently wrong constant emitted (release).
bugs.expected: lossless bitwise round-trip for every finite f64
bugs.actual: panic 'attempt to subtract with overflow' at long_double.rs:1040 in debug; wrapped garbage exponent in release
bugs.counterexample: x = 0.5 (biased_exp = 1022 < 1023): 'd.biased_exp as u128 - 1023' underflows -> panic 'attempt to subtract with overflow' in debug, garbage exponent in release. Also x = f64::from_bits(1) (subnormal, biased_exp = 0).
bugs.fix: Compute the exponent without an unsigned intermediate underflow, e.g. (d.biased_exp as u128 + 16383 - 1023) or via i32; add a subnormal branch that normalizes the mantissa.

bugs.summary: f128 single-rounding law broken (same root cause as b1: any |operand| < 1.0 panics inside f64_to_f128_bytes_lossless before f128 arithmetic is reached)
bugs.impact: Compile-time long double arithmetic on ARM64/RISC-V cannot fold any expression with an operand below 1.0; after fixing b1 this property additionally pins the f128_bytes_to_f64 truncation (b3).
bugs.expected: f128_bytes_to_f64(f128_op(enc(a), enc(b))) bitwise-equal to native f64 a op b for f64-exact operands
bugs.actual: panic 'attempt to subtract with overflow' at long_double.rs:1040 inside the operand conversion
bugs.counterexample: any operand pair with |a| < 1.0 or |b| < 1.0 (e.g. a = 0.5): panics inside f64_to_f128_bytes_lossless (same root cause as b1); once that is fixed this property also isolates the f128_bytes_to_f64 truncation (b3)
bugs.fix: Same fix as b1; then re-run this property to confirm agreement with native f64 (which will additionally exercise the b3 rounding fix).

bugs.summary: f64_to_x87_bytes_simple mis-encodes subnormal f64 values (assumes implicit leading 1)
bugs.impact: Subnormal double constants through the x86/i686 path become ~2^752 times larger — silent wrong constant.
bugs.expected: decode-back to the original subnormal value (widening is exact per its own doc)
bugs.counterexample: x = f64::from_bits(1) = 5e-324 (smallest positive subnormal): encoded as ~2.22e-308 (implicit-leading-1 assumption on a subnormal mantissa), decodes to +0.0 (bits 0x0 vs expected 0x1)
bugs.fix: Add a subnormal branch: normalize the mantissa to explicit-integer-bit form with a correspondingly smaller exponent.
bugs.documentedBehavior: src/common/long_double.rs:1141 "This is a widening conversion that zero-fills the extra mantissa bits."

bugs.summary: f128_bytes_to_f64 truncates instead of rounding to nearest — disagrees with same-job sibling x87_to_f64 called by the same caller (eval_const_binop_float) into the same IrConst slot
bugs.impact: Every folded long double Add/Sub/Mul/Div/Mod constant on ARM64/RISC-V (const_arith.rs:174-190) stores an approx 1 ulp away from the correctly-rounded value; by the single-rounding law it differs bitwise from native f64 arithmetic on f64-exact operands.
bugs.expected: round-to-nearest-even narrowing, bitwise-equal to the sibling converter for the same value (2.0 for the witness)
bugs.counterexample: x87 2^0 x 1.111...1 (all-ones 64-bit mantissa, bytes[..8]=u64::MAX.to_le_bytes(), exp=0x3FFF): direct (round-to-nearest) = 2.0, via exact f128 bridge (truncating) = 1.9999999999999998
bugs.fix: Mirror x87_bytes_to_f64's rounding (round bit = stored bit 59, sticky = bits 58..0, tie-to-even, mantissa-overflow carry into the exponent).
bugs.documentedBehavior: src/common/long_double.rs:655 "Round to nearest: check bit 10 (the first dropped bit)" (same-job sibling x87_bytes_to_f64; the same caller const_arith.rs:239 uses it for the identical IrConst approx slot)

bugs.summary: __builtin_bswap32 folds unsigned results >= 2^31 into signed I32, violating the module's own zero-extension rule
bugs.impact: (__int128)__builtin_bswap32(x)-style widening via eval_const_binop_i128 sign-extends the wrong representation; any consumer reading to_i64() gets a negative value for an unsigned-int constant.
bugs.expected: folded constant zero-extended: 4290586368 for the witness
bugs.counterexample: __builtin_bswap32 with v = -5495501120125551105 (low u32 after bswap = 0xFFBBD010 >= 2^31): folded constant reads back -4380928 (signed I32) instead of 4290586368 (zero-extended unsigned int)
bugs.fix: Store the result zero-extended like the arithmetic path does: Some(IrConst::I64(v.swap_bytes() as u64 as i64)).
bugs.documentedBehavior: src/common/const_arith.rs:88-96 "For unsigned 32-bit results, we must use I64 with zero-extension because IrConst::I32 is signed and cannot correctly represent unsigned values >= 2^31. ... Using I64(4294967295) preserves the correct unsigned value."
